The cleaner covers your temporary files,: The cleaner covers your temporary files, Windows temporary files, Prefetch data, Windows Update leftovers, Windows error reports, the Recycle Bin, the Windows Disk Cleanup profile and the component store (WinSxS). Prefetch, the Recycle Bin and the component store are never chosen automatically.
